question: Which dynasty succeeded the Mauryan Empire?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shunga Dynasty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Shunga Dynasty was established by **Pushyamitra Shunga**, who overthrew the Mauryan emperor Brihadratha in 185 BCE.
 
• Pushyamitra Shunga was originally a **commander-in-chief** in the Mauryan army.
 
• The Shunga Dynasty ruled over parts of northern and central India, with its capital at **Pataliputra**.
 
• The reign of the Shunga Dynasty is marked by the revival of **Brahmanical traditions** and the decline of Buddhism.
 
• The Shunga rulers were patrons of art and architecture, contributing significantly to the construction of **stupas and temples**, including enhancements to the Bharhut and Sanchi stupas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pushyamitra Shunga:**

 
 
• He was the founder of the Shunga Dynasty and ruled from 185 BCE to 149 BCE.
 
• He is known for conducting **Vedic sacrifices** such as the Ashvamedha Yajna (horse sacrifice).
 
 
 
• **Decline of Buddhism:**
 
 
• The Shunga period saw a decline in royal patronage for Buddhism, although common people continued to practice it.
 
• The dynasty supported **Brahmanical Hinduism**, leading to a cultural shift.
 
 
 
• **Art and Architecture:**
 
 
• The Shunga rulers are known for their contributions to Indian art, particularly in the form of stupas like Bharhut and Sanchi.
 
• The period also witnessed the development of early Hindu temple architecture.
 
 
 
• **Kanva Dynasty:**
 
 
• The Kanva Dynasty succeeded the Shunga Dynasty after its decline around 73 BCE.
 
• The Kanva rulers were Brahmanical and continued the cultural legacy initiated by the Shungas.
